subject: Staged invoice acceptance and dynamic net-term plan for onboarding
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marlene Ortiz <marlene@clearpay.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged invoice acceptance and dynamic net-term plan for onboarding

Hi Marlene —

Thanks again for the quick responses during the vendor intake. A few items for us to lock so we can get the PO issued and the first invoice paid without delay:

- Please complete the attached onboarding_form.pdf and return with your preferred remit details (ACH/Wire, bank account, remit email).
- We typically issue a PO using our PO_template.docx; confirm if you need any vendor legal name variation on the PO.
- Redwood policy defaults to Net45 for new vendors, but we can be flexible. Can you confirm if ClearPay requires Net60 standard or if Net45/Net30 is possible for the first 60 days?

To get us a middle ground, are you open to a staged plan: onboarding/setup invoices (first two invoices) paid Net30, then ongoing monthly invoices move to Net45? We also run a 10-day early-pay program (1% discount) and a 2% early-pay option via our payment partner for vendors who opt in. If ClearPay wants to participate in the early-pay program, we can map that in the PO so your AR team sees it.

Attach: onboarding_form.pdf, PO_template.docx.

Please return the completed form and a sample invoice (sample_invoice_001.pdf is fine) so Finance can validate your remit. If we get this confirmed by Friday, I will ask Rishi to issue the PO and we can target vendor activation next week.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Marlene Ortiz <marlene@clearpay.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: FinanceOps <finance@clearpay.io>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Staged invoice acceptance and dynamic net-term plan for onboarding

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for outlining the options. ClearPay's standard AR terms are Net60; historically our models expect that cadence. That said, we can do Net45 for the first 90 days if Redwood can accommodate that in the PO. We are interested in the early-pay program but need to understand settlement mechanics (ACH vs. card-based pay). Our preference is ACH with remittance email accounts@clearpay.io.

Attached: vendor_w9.pdf and a sample_invoice_001.pdf for your finance team to test. We would ask for the PO to include explicit line items for onboarding services (so we can match remittance).

Quick Qs:
- Does Redwood require vendor tax ID on the PO?
- Can you send the PO number format so we can reconcile automatically?

Best,
Marlene Ortiz
Head of Finance Operations
ClearPay Inc.
marlene@clearpay.io | +1 (212) 555-2199

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marlene Ortiz <marlene@clearpay.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged invoice acceptance and dynamic net-term plan for onboarding

Thanks both — quick operational note from Procurement Ops:

Proposal we recommend and can operationalize immediately:
1) First two invoices (onboarding/setup): Net30 to help ClearPay's cashflow during initial ramp.
2) Ongoing monthly invoices: Net45 standard.
3) Early-pay option: 1% discount if Redwood pays within 10 days (this is a Redwood-branded program, settled via ACH). ClearPay can opt in for the larger 2% via our payment partner if desired — that requires enrollment and a settlement fee.

Marlene: we do require the vendor tax ID on the PO for automated matching. PO numbers follow PO-YYYY-#### (we'll provide the concrete number once issued).

I attached a signed_po_template.docx (stub) with fields we will populate. Rishi — can you run a quick impact check on cashflow for the first quarter if we accept the staged Net30 -> Net45? If OK, I'll proceed to ask Legal to lock the PO language and include the early-pay clause.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marlene Ortiz <marlene@clearpay.io>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged invoice acceptance and dynamic net-term plan for onboarding

All — reviewed and approved. Finance is comfortable issuing a PO with the following conditions:
- PO number: PO-2027-0471 (finalized_po_PO-2027-0471.pdf attached)
- Payment ladder: Invoice 1 & 2 = Net30; subsequent invoices = Net45
- Early-pay: 1% discount for payment within 10 days (opt-in). ClearPay can enroll for the 2% partner discount separately if desired.
- Remit: ACH to bank account provided on vendor_w9.pdf, remit email accounts@clearpay.io.

Rishi has attached the finalized PO and will push the DocuSign request to Marlene. Marlene — once the onboarding_form.pdf is signed and returned I will release the PO and mark vendor as active.

Link to DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/PO-2027-0471
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/onboarding/clearpay

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff next week.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance Programs
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
